description: Name under which the product will be sold; must appear in the same field of vision with the alcohol content and class/type designation.

mandatory_item_name: Designation Class/Type or Distinctive/Fanciful Name with Statement of Composition
description: Class/type designation (e.g., Vodka, Chocolate Flavored Brandy) or a distinctive/fanciful name together with a truthful and adequate statement of composition; must appear in the same field of vision with brand name and alcohol content when required.
Statement of alcohol content as a percentage by volume; must appear in the same field of vision with the brand name and class/type designation and use acceptable formats/abbreviations.
Volume of distilled spirits in the container; must meet approved standards of fill and use acceptable metric formats (e.g., 500 mL, 1.5 L).

Name (or trade name) and address (city and State) as listed on your permit; for domestic use 'Bottled By' and for imported 'Imported By' phrasing must immediately precede the name/address with no intervening text.
Government health warning statement must appear exactly as prescribed, with 'GOVERNMENT WARNING' in capital letters and bold type and the prescribed wording and punctuation.
Country of origin statement required for imported distilled spirits; must comply with U.S. Customs and Border Protection rules.
If total sulfur dioxide is 10 ppm or more, label must state 'Contains Sulfites' (or equivalent disclosure).
When certain coloring materials are used, label must state the specific coloring material (e.g., 'Colored With Caramel') or an appropriate disclosure such as 'Artificially Colored'.
If FD&C Yellow No. 5 is used, the label must specifically disclose 'Contains FD&C Yellow No. 5' either as part of a statement of composition or a separate disclosure.
If cochineal extract or carmine is used, the label must specifically disclose that fact (e.g., 'Contains Carmine').
For whisky and brandy treated with wood other than contact with oak containers, label must state 'Colored and flavored with wood' (or similar) when applicable, subject to exceptions and limits.

mandatory_item_name: Commodity Statements (Presence of Neutral Spirits / Commodity of Distillation)
description: When neutral spirits are used in blending/rectification, disclose percentage of neutral spirits and the commodity from which distilled; for neutral spirits or gin from continuous distillation, state the commodity (e.g., 'Distilled from Potato').
For certain U.S. whiskies, the State of distillation must be shown if the whisky is not distilled in the State given in the address on the label.
Age statements (e.g., '3 Years Old', 'Aged not less than 6 months') are mandatory in specified circumstances and must use approved formats.
